note: Run BEFORE interpreting the pilot. Confirms the checkpoints are not degenerate: with SUSTAINED opposite actions the models track ~30% of the true effect, so they do respond to actions. The pilot's near-zero causal response therefore reflects a DELAYED single-cause effect being lost, not a dead model.
caveat: PREDICTION QUALITY IS MEDIOCRE (pixel MSE 179-369 on a 0-255 scale). The obvious a reader objection -- 'your world models are weak, that is why they lose causes' -- is NOT yet answered. Any claim must either use a better-trained model or show the effect is independent of prediction quality.
